title: Illustration 42: Rader, Lewin & Prittie
content: The new issue of Illustration 42 is available. It includes the paperback art of Paul Rader, the life work and story of Children’s Book illustrator Ted Lewin, told by himself, and a profile of Edwin John Prittie, known for the Horrors of War bubblegum cards.You can preview the whole issue at the Illustration website.
